arxiv-2311-01994.title: Obtaining Explainable Classification Models using Distributionally Robust Optimization
arxiv-2311-01994.creator: Sanjeeb Dash, Soumyadip Ghosh, João Gonçalves, Mark S. Squillante
arxiv-2311-01994.description: Abstract Model explainability is crucial for human users to be able to interpret how a proposed classifier assigns labels to data based on its feature values. We study generalized linear models constructed using sets of feature value rules, which can capture nonlinear dependencies and interactions. An inherent trade-off exists between rule set sparsity and its prediction accuracy.

arxiv-2503-10353.title: A categorical perspective on constraint satisfaction: The wonderland of adjunctions
arxiv-2503-10353.creator: Maximilian Hadek, Tomáš Jakl, Jakub Opršal
arxiv-2503-10353.description: Abstract The so-called algebraic approach to the constraint satisfaction problem (CSP) has been a prevalent method of the study of complexity of these problems since early 2000’s. The core of this approach is the notion of polymorphisms which determine the complexity of the problem (up to log-space reductions).

arxiv-2507-17851.title: Speaker Disentanglement of Speech Pre-trained Model Based on Interpretability
arxiv-2507-17851.creator: Xiaoxu Zhu, Junhua Li
arxiv-2507-17851.description: Abstract In recent years, Large Language Models have made significant progress in processing text, images, and audio information. In the field of speech, the introduction of large-scale, self-supervised pretraining techniques has greatly enhanced the speech generation quality and task generalization ability of speech models.

arxiv-2512-20107.title: UMAMI: Unifying Masked Autoregressive Models and Deterministic Rendering for View Synthesis
arxiv-2512-20107.creator: Thanh-Tung Le Tuan Pham Tung Nguyen, Deying Kong Xiaohui Xie Stephan Mandt
arxiv-2512-20107.description: Abstract Novel view synthesis (NVS) seeks to render photorealistic, 3D - consistent images of a scene from unseen camera poses given only a sparse set of posed views. Existing deterministic networks render observed regions quickly but blur unobserved areas, whereas stochastic diffusion - based methods hallucinate plausible content yet incur heavy training - and inference - time costs.

britannica-1911-mercia.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-mercia.description: Article 'Mercia' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. the Trent, comprising the greater part of Derbyshire and Staffordshire, the northern parts of Warwickshire and Leicestershire, and the southern part of Nottinghamshire. The name (Merce) seems to denote men of the March, and presumably was first applied when this district bordered upon the Welsh. In later times Mercia successively absorbed all the other territories between the Humber and the Thames except East Anglia, and some districts even beyond the Thames.

pmc-11286610.title: IL-22 activates the PI3K-AKT pathway to promote colorectal cancer cell proliferation and metastasis
pmc-11286610.creator: Hong-xun Ruan, Xiao-ning Qin, Wei Huang, Lin Lin
pmc-11286610.description: BackgroundColorectal cancer (CRC) is a prevalent malignancy with high morbidity and mortality rates. Previous studies have demonstrated that interleukin (IL)-22 is involved in CRC progression; however, the exact mechanism remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the effects of IL-22 on CRC cell proliferation and metastasis.

pmc-11348992.title: Circulating Exosomal microRNA Profiles Associated with Risk of Postoperative Recurrence in Chronic Rhinosinusitis with Nasal Polyps
pmc-11348992.creator: Siyuan Chen, Jia Liu, Zhili Feng, Liubo Zhou, Yuexiang Cai, Qiancheng Jing
pmc-11348992.description: BackgroundExosomes carry various types of transcripts and serve as promising biomarkers for inflammatory diseases. However, the role of serum exosomal microRNAs (miRNAs) in chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP) is poorly clarified.MethodsA prospective exploratory cohort of 10 CRSwNP patients was conducted, and the serum exosome samples were subjected to miRNA sequencing.

pmc-11391015.title: Haplotype variability in mitochondrial rRNA predisposes to metabolic syndrome
pmc-11391015.creator: Petr Pecina, Kristýna Čunátová, Vilma Kaplanová, Guillermo Puertas-Frias, Jan Šilhavý, Kateřina Tauchmannová, Marek Vrbacký, Tomáš Čajka, Ondřej Gahura, Markéta Hlaváčková, Viktor Stránecký, Stanislav Kmoch, Michal Pravenec, Josef Houštěk, Tomáš Mráček, Alena Pecinová
pmc-11391015.description: Metabolic syndrome is a growing concern in developed societies and due to its polygenic nature, the genetic component is only slowly being elucidated. Common mitochondrial DNA sequence variants have been associated with symptoms of metabolic syndrome and may, therefore, be relevant players in the genetics of metabolic syndrome.

pmc-11474828.title: Dendritic cells pulsed with multifunctional Wilms’ tumor 1 (WT1) peptides combined with multiagent chemotherapy modulate the tumor microenvironment and enable conversion surgery in pancreatic cancer
pmc-11474828.creator: Shigeo Koido, Junichi Taguchi, Masamori Shimabuku, Shin Kan, Tuuse Bito, Takeyuki Misawa, Zensho Ito, Kan Uchiyama, Masayuki Saruta, Shintaro Tsukinaga, Machi Suka, Hiroyuki Yanagisawa, Nobuhiro Sato, Toshifumi Ohkusa, Shigetaka Shimodaira, Haruo Sugiyama
pmc-11474828.description: BackgroundWe aimed to develop a chemoimmunotherapy regimen consisting of a novel Wilms’ tumor 1 (WT1) peptide-pulsed dendritic cell (WT1-DC) vaccine and multiagent chemotherapy and to investigate the safety, clinical outcomes, and WT1-specific immune responses of patients with unresectable advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (UR-PDAC) who received this treatment.

pmc-11625891.title: Early-life challenge enhances cortisol regulation in zebrafish larvae
pmc-11625891.creator: Luis A Castillo-Ramírez, Ulrich Herget, Soojin Ryu, Rodrigo J De Marco
pmc-11625891.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis in mammals and the hypothalamic-pituitary-interrenal (HPI) axis in fish are open systems that adapt to the environment during development. Little is known about how this adaptation begins and regulates early stress responses. We used larval zebrafish to examine the impact of prolonged forced swimming at 5 days post-fertilization (dpf), termed early-life challenge (ELC), on cortisol responses, neuropeptide expression in the nucleus preopticus (NPO), and gene transcript levels.

pmc-11649387.title: The effects of a bioavailable curcumin formulation on Alzheimer's disease pathologies: A potential risk for neuroinflammation
pmc-11649387.creator: Shaun Cade, Clive Prestidge, Xin‐Fu Zhou, Larisa Bobrovskaya
pmc-11649387.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a common cause of dementia characterized by the presence of two proteinaceous deposits in the brain. These pathologies may be a consequence of complex interactions between neurons and glia before the onset of cognitive impairments. Curcumin, a bioactive compound found in turmeric, is a promising candidate for AD because it alleviates neuropathologies in mouse models of the disease. Although its clinical efficacy has been hindered by low oral bioavailability, the development of new formulations may overcome this limitation.

pmc-11859511.title: Paraphrenia – current psychopathological and diagnoses landmarks
pmc-11859511.creator: E. Lukacs, A. Nirestean, L. M. Grebenisan, A. Sima Comaniciu, E. G. Strete
pmc-11859511.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionParaphrenia, classically known as a chronic delusional-hallucinatory psychosis, currently has an uncertain nosological status, not being included in DSM-5 either. It can be integrated into the group of schizophrenic and delusional psychoses, but with obvious distinctive attributes. Currently, in the context of the increase in the incidence of childhood autism, the psychopathological pictures from the spectrum of psychoses in adulthood are also diversifying.

pmc-12752853.description: Breast cancer is a real public health problem. Several women with this disease have died from it. Breast cancer is one of the deadliest cancers. Currently, the only way to combat this scourge is the early detection of breast masses.

pmc-12852531.title: Research trends and emerging frontiers of tumor-associated macrophages in gastric cancer: a bibliometric analysis
pmc-12852531.creator: Chao Han, Chen Huang, Yuan Fang
pmc-12852531.description: BackgroundTumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) constitute pivotal cellular constituents within the tumor microenvironment (TME), exerting profound influences on gastric cancer (GC) pathogenesis and progression. This bibliometric investigation systematically evaluates worldwide research trends, delineates predominant contributing entities, and elucidates evolving research frontiers in this domain.

pmc-13198117.title: Presumed Postural Tachycardia Syndrome
pmc-13198117.creator: Diego Ramonfaur, Iqbal El-Assaad, Kenneth A Mayuga
pmc-13198117.description: BackgroundTilt table testing is commonly used to evaluate orthostatic intolerance and syncope and is typically performed with three-lead electrocardiography (ECG) monitoring, which limits P-wave interpretation.Case SummaryA 21-year-old woman with congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries presented with recurrent tachy-palpitations and near syncope and was presumed to have postural tachycardia syndrome (POTS) after extensive noninvasive testing.
